name: Ingest and quarantine
purpose: external events enter safely, once, and untrusted text is turned into typed data without any model being able to act on it.
exit_gate: forged and replayed webhooks rejected; injection corpus produces no instruction-bearing output.
traps: never log event bodies; answer webhooks fast and process later.
note: `passes` is set only by CI after a task's acceptance tests pass there. Dependencies default to the previous task in the phase; loosen them when tasks are independent. Areas are a first guess; one agent per area at a time.

tasks.title: Event envelope and `events` table with the unique key; async processing after commit.
spec_refs: README: Ingest and event adapter, Company brain (Extraction pipeline), Security model (Inbound webhooks, Prompt injection).
acceptance: forged signatures, stale timestamps and replays rejected; duplicate deliveries produce one event; injection corpus produces no instruction-bearing output (output is only typed fields that validate); taint propagates to every derived row.
